{"code": "from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Stratify by severity and compute mean change within each severity level
stratified_change = data.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['biomarker_change'].mean().unstack(level='severity')

# Compute the difference in change within each severity group
strat_diff = stratified_change['severe'] - stratified_change['mild']

# Compute the weighted average difference across severity groups
# Weight by the number of patients in each group within each arm
n_mild_control = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'mild')].shape[0]
n_moderate_control = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')].shape[0]
n_severe_control = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'severe')].shape[0]
n_mild_treatment = data[(data['arm'] == 'treatment') & (data['severity'] == 'mild')].shape[0]
n_moderate_treatment = data[(data['arm'] == 'treatment') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')].shape[0]
n_severe_treatment = data[(data['arm'] == 'treatment') & (data['severity'] == 'severe')].shape[0]

# Total patients by arm
n_control = n_mild_control + n_moderate_control + n_severe_control
n_treatment = n_mild_treatment + n_moderate_treatment + n_severe_treatment

# Compute weighted average change per arm
weighted_change_control = (
    (n_mild_control * stratified_change.loc['control', 'mild']) +
    (n_moderate_control * stratified_change.loc['control', 'moderate']) +
    (n_severe_control * stratified_change.loc['control', 'severe'])
) / n_control

weighted_change_treatment = (
    (n_mild_treatment * stratified_change.loc['treatment', 'mild']) +
    (n_moderate_treatment * stratified_change.loc['treatment', 'moderate']) +
    (n_severe_treatment * stratified_change.loc['treatment', 'severe'])
) / n_treatment

# Compute difference
weighted_diff = weighted_change_treatment - weighted_change_control

print(f"Weighted average change in treatment arm: {weighted_change_treatment}")
print(f"Weighted average change in control arm: {weighted_change_control}")
print(f"Weighted difference (treatment - control): {weighted_diff}")"}
